title: Choose MalaMaster's visual world
question: The roll assigned Kopitiam Melamine & Basket. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Kopitiam Melamine & Basket
options.lineage: Hawker-centre melamine bowls and the red plastic mala basket
options.thesis: The bowl you are filling is the interface: jade melamine ground, red woven basket, weight read off the scale.
options.viewport: Top: big scale readout (grams, S$) over a red basket that fills by tier colour; below: tier tabs and ingredient tiles with +/- tongs.
options.risk: Green-and-red can read festive or muddy if the jade is not deep and the red is not reserved for the basket.

raised.raise: Weight and price sit in fixed tabular cells that change in place, never reflowing.
Each price tier owns one colour used everywhere: tile edge, basket fill, receipt line.
One monumental number per screen: the scale weight, everything else secondary.
Orders stamp their outcome (Spot on / Over / Under) onto the order chit; nothing disappears.

options.label: Stall Price Board
options.lineage: Laminated tier price boards over steel ingredient trays
options.thesis: The stall's own laminated price board, chili-oil red header, ingredients in steel trays by tier.
options.viewport: Red header with running total; tier rows as steel trays of ingredient tiles; sticky price board strip.
options.risk: The literal reading of a mala app; most runs in this category land on red-and-chili.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, one action colour only where you can press.
options.viewport: Total card on top, ingredient cards in one column, bottom bar for Practice / Orders / Board.
options.case: Holds clarity, easy one-handed; loses on audience identification: nothing says mala stall.

options.label: Ingredient Character Roster
options.thesis: Every ingredient is a little character with a name plate and one line about its weight.
options.viewport: A ranked roster grid of ingredient characters; tap to add; total pinned at top.
options.case: Strong for a friends game; loses on clarity: cute cells hide the weight numbers.
options.risk: Drawing 30 ingredient characters well is real art work; weak art cheapens it.

options.label: Terminal Yellow Wayfinding
options.thesis: One yellow band, one next decision.
options.viewport: Monumental weight on a yellow band.
options.risk: Feels like an airport, not a hawker centre.
options.case: Clear, but players do not see themselves in an airport.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Totals flip like a departure board.
options.kept: Fixed cells that change in place.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve Code
options.thesis: Colour blocks stand in for words.
options.viewport: A coded colour strip of your bowl.
options.risk: Too cryptic for a quick game.
options.case: Cryptic for friends at a stall.
options.kept: Tier colour as a strict code.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean casual-game UI: white cards, one bright accent, big score.
canonCard.viewport: Score header, ingredient grid, bottom tabs.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other tap game.
